d:
Bihar ke mokama (nadvan ganv) se purv vidhayak anant sinh ki beti ki bhavy shadi ab sirph sthaniy ya rashtriy star tak simit nahin rahi, balki antarrashtriy midiya men bhi bari surkhiyan bator rahi hai. karib char lakh mehmanon, 500 rasoiyon aur chhah helipaid ke intjamon ke bich videshi akhbaron aur chainlon ne is aayojan ko bihar ki garibi, daulat ke pradarshan aur samajik asmanta ke sandarbh men dikhaya hai.
Is khas riport men janie ki videshi midiya ne is shadi ko kis najrie se dekha:
Da garjiyan (The Guardian): bihar ki aarthik sthiti aur asmanta par kya bare saval uthae gae?
